sidedness: two-sided test; positive direction required for support
statistic: mean of 24 complete five-fold-averaged paired draw differences (pp UAR)
test: two-sided one-sample Student t test; Holm family size 1
aggregation: select within fold; difference cells within fold; average five folds within draw; infer across draws
missing_rule: one initial attempt plus at most one identical retry per unit; second failure voids draw; replace in order with reserve 24..27; fewer than 24 complete => not tested (incomplete)
stopping_rule: fixed 24 complete draws; maximum 28 activated draws and 2 attempts per unit; no hard GPU-hour cap; no effect-based interim scoring or efficacy/futility stop
sesoi_or_margin: design alternative 1.5 pp with SD 2.5 pp
